details: Bitcoin's price has climbed above $80,000, with some analysts noting it as a significant milestone after strong inflows into US spot Bitcoin ETFs, marking an eighth consecutive day of positive inflows totaling around $2.8 billion. This surge is contributing to a broader market rally.
title: Bitcoin Surges Past $80,000 Amid Strong ETF Inflows

details: Charles Schwab is expanding its retail crypto trading platform, Schwab Crypto, by adding support for Solana (SOL), Avalanche (AVAX), and Chainlink (LINK). These altcoins are expected to roll out in the coming months, building on their existing offerings of Bitcoin and Ethereum.
title: Charles Schwab to Add Solana, Avalanche, and Chainlink to Crypto Platform

details: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has submitted a proposal to the White House aimed at modernizing and clarifying the regulatory framework for the custody of crypto assets for investment advisers and companies. This move seeks to improve and streamline regulations in the crypto space.
title: SEC Sends Proposal to White House on Crypto Custody Rules

details: Grayscale has launched the world's first Zcash ETF, ZCSH, which is now trading on NYSE Arca, providing investors with exposure to ZEC through traditional brokerage accounts. This development coincides with a significant rally in Zcash's price, reaching near $800, and an increase in shielded transactions.
title: Grayscale Launches First U.S. Zcash ETF (ZCSH)

details: The United Kingdom plans to grant the Bank of England a new statutory objective to foster innovation in stablecoins and other forms of digital money. This objective aims to support the evolving digital asset landscape while maintaining financial stability as a core responsibility.
title: UK Bank of England to Get New Objective for Stablecoins
